text:
Mia: Heads-up — CatalystEdge just sent an updated forecast. They want to tighten their Q4 commit by ~35% but still expect full burstability during product launch windows. We need to reconcile before the renewal call.
Jordan: Do we have their per-region profile? EU-west and us-west were the big ones last year.
Sam K.: I pulled their telemetry — sustained GPU-hours dropped, but peak TPS during launches is unchanged. So they need burst, not baseline.
Rahul: Important: EU-west has limited H100 availability in our reserved pool that quarter. If they insist on region pinning, cost goes up.
Elise (AM): CatalystEdge is pushing back on added cost. They expect the same unit price even if we move some capacity to on-demand H100s for bursts.
Mia: Outline of options I'm proposing before call: 1) Keep baseline commit (-35%) + 20% cushion for scheduled launches, 2) Keep baseline commit + swap some burst to shared burst credits (cheaper), 3) Remove strict region pinning and add cross-region failover.
Jordan: Quick numbers: their old commit = 180k GPU-hours/mo. New ask ~117k. If we add 20% cushion for launches that's ~140k committed, plus a burst bucket.
Sam K.: If we keep their unit price and add on-demand H100 for eu-west bursts, margin falls ~18%. If they accept shared burst credits instead of reserved H100, margin hit is ~6%.
Elise (AM): We should propose option 2 with a fallback to 1 if they want predictability. Sales prefers a predictable monthly ARR number.
Rahul: Also note networking egress: their product uses cross-region embeddings lookup — multi-region 99p95 latency requirement could force us to provision extra inter-region bandwidth during launches. That's another cost.
Mia: Can ops estimate extra egress cost for peak windows? We need a ballpark to present.
ops-bot: autoscaler: projected queue depth spike for catalystedge-launch at 2029-11-12T04:00Z -> expected +220% for 3h. Suggested pre-warm: +32 H100s.
Sam K.: Pre-warm 32 H100s for 3h x launch event = ~96 GPU-hours per launch. If they have 6 launches, that's ~576 GPU-hours — small relative to commit but matters for cushion policy.
Jordan: Cushion policy reminder: default commit cushion is 10% of committed GPU-hours unless customer negotiates explicit tranche. We can offer a tiered cushion: 10% baseline, 50% of predicted launch hours as refundable burst credits.
Elise (AM): I'll float that to CatalystEdge — tiered cushion sounds acceptable. Also ask them to loosen strict region pinning for non-launch traffic.
Mia: Action items: Sam — compute cost delta for shared burst credits vs reserved on-demand H100s and include egress estimate. Rahul — confirm region availability for target dates and whether cross-region failover would break any SLA clauses. Elise — present tiered cushion and see if they accept partial region flexibility.
Sam K.: Will do, sending numbers by EOD.
Rahul: I'll check capacity and post here by lunchtime.
Elise (AM): Scheduling renewal call for Fri 16:00 PT. I'll include the cushion proposal and two pricing options.
Mia: Thanks — if we can keep the negotiated margin impact <10% we can accept. Otherwise we push for slight price uplift or require region flexibility.
Jordan: +1. Also log this under customer-tranches for audit.
Mia: tagging @ops-bot for pre-warm automation when/if deal closes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: noted — will create pre-warm runbook draft once capacity is confirmed.
